## Schouwink et al. (2011), 300 K BM2

Identifier: `fe2o3_schouwink_2011_bm2_1`.

Availability: **Executable**.

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.


- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Schouwink; Dubrovinsky; Glazyrin; Merlini; Hanfland; Pippinger; Miletich
    - **Year:** 2011
    - **Title:** High-pressure structural behavior of α-Fe2O3 studied by single-crystal X-ray diffraction and synchrotron radiation up to 25 GPa
    - **Source:** Am. Mineral.
    - **Volume:** 96
    - **Locator:** 1781-1786
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am.2011.3775
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0.0, 25.3\]

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 301.88 | 0.02 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0 | 207.0 | 3.0 | Not listed |

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported
meaning; an absent error is unknown, and absence of covariance does not
establish statistical independence.

Recommended finite-strain result from neon-medium single-crystal XRD to 25.3 GPa. Second-order Birch-Murnaghan fixes K0'=4 by definition; the unconstrained alternative was not selected.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### hematite\_schouwink\_2011\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** All ten single-crystal hematite structural refinements printed in Table 1, including lattice parameters, cell volume, atomic coordinates, and refinement residual.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_structure
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Schouwink; Dubrovinsky; Glazyrin; Merlini; Hanfland; Pippinger; Miletich
    - **Year:** 2011
    - **Source:** Am. Mineral.
    - **Volume:** 96
    - **Locator:** 1781-1786
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am.2011.3775
- **Source location:** Table 1, journal page 1782
- **Associated EOS records:** fe2o3\_schouwink\_2011\_bm2\_1
- **Notes:** The near-ambient pressure is preserved as the printed 10^-5 GPa value. Pressure was measured by ruby fluorescence and cross-checked with solid neon; pressures were measured before and after each collection. Parenthesized structural-refinement uncertainties are retained as printed.
